descriptions.w3d_s20_get_byte_slot_801a9b04: Appears to return the byte at the given index of the byte table at offset 304.
descriptions.w3d_s20_set_byte_slot_801a9af4: Appears to store a byte at the given index of the byte table at offset 304 and return zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_clear_word_slot_801a314c: Appears to clear one word of the array pointed to at offset 72 and return zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_sum_bytes_80177e04: Appears to add the four bytes of a 32-bit value and return the low byte of the sum.
descriptions.w3d_s20_sum_bytes_8017e1a0: Appears to add the four bytes of a 32-bit value and return the low byte of the sum.
descriptions.w3d_s20_has_record_key_80199f68: Appears to scan 24-byte records between two pointers for a 16-bit key at offset 18 and return 1 if found.
descriptions.w3d_s20_evaluate_polynomial_80197244: Appears to evaluate a polynomial of the given degree with Horner's rule over a float coefficient array.
descriptions.w3d_s20_select_band_801d69dc: Appears to return one of two float constants depending on whether the value lies in a range between two constants.
descriptions.w3d_s20_any_handle_set_8013f844: Appears to return 1 if any of three handle fields at offsets 144, 140 and 148 is not minus one.
